items.text: Oburume bwabeechi ekhumi nababili
Mana yalanga abo Ekhumi-nababili halala, nabaheelesia amaani nende obunyali khumadimoni kosi, khandi nende okhuhonia obulwale.
Nabaruma okhwilwatsa akobwami bwaNyasaye nokhuhonia abalwale.
Nababoolela mbu Murabukulakhwo eshindu shiosi shioluchendo Iweenywe ta, kata indabushi, kata omufuuko, kata omukaate, kata amapeesa; kata omundu araba netsingubo tsiomukari tsibili tawe.
Ne munzu yosi eya muleenjilamwo, mumenye mubwenomwo, murule mubwenomwo nimwinyokha.
Nabo bosi abaramwinjisia ta, olwa murula mwitookho omwo muteng'ulule olufu olwokhubilenje bieenywe, khube oburumbusi khubo okhubafukula.
Nibatsia, nibabira mumataala kosi, nibeelwatsanga Injiili, nibahoninjia abandu hosi hosi.
Okhufwa khwaYohana Omubatisii
Ne Herode omuruchi yahulila khukosi akali nikeekholanga; nanyakhana muno mumwoyo, shichila abandi bali nibaboolanga mbu Yohana walamuushe mubafu;
nabandi, mbu Eliya waloleeshe; nabandi, mbu mulala khubalakusi bakhale walamuushe khandi.
Naye Herode naboola mbu Yohana ndamurema omurwe; ne uno niye wina, owa embulilangakhwo amakhuwa akafwana kario? Nakhaaba okhumulola.
Yesu yaliisia abandu ebikhumila biraano
Abarume nabo, olwa bali nibakaluushe, bamurumbulila Yesu amakhuwa aka bali nibakholile. Nababukula, narulaho ninabo bonyene natsia mwitaala elilangwa mbu Betsesaida.
Nabemikanda olwa bamanya bario, bamulondakhwo; nabeenjisia, nasungana ninabo khumakhuwa kobwami bwaNyasaye; nabo abali nibakhoyile okhuhonibwa, yabahonia.

Mana eshialo shiali nishiilukhana; nabo Ekhumi-nababili nibeetsa, nibamusunjila bari Obaseebule abemikanda batsie mumataala nende mubisoma ebirondokhana banyoole obukono nende ebiokhulia; shichila aha khuli hano neshitsiimi.

Ne yabasunjila mbu Inywe mubaheelesie eshiokhulia. Nibasunga bari Shikhulikhwo nende eshindu ta, habula emikaate chiraano nende tsinyeeni tsibili, nikhurakhatsia okhubakulila abandu bano bosi ebiliibwa.
Shichila bali abasaatsa shinga ebikhumila biraano. Nababoolela abeechibe ari Mubeekhasie ebituma ebituma, buli shituma abandu shinga amakhumi karaano.
Nibakhola bario, nibabeekhasia bosi.
Naye nabukula emikaate echio chiraano netsinyeeni tsibili, nahenga mwikulu nabisabila ikhabi, nabisonyola; nakabila abeechibe mbu babarenjeshele abemikanda.
Nibalia nibeekura bosi; ebisonye ebiabatong'ela nibikhung'aasibwa, ebimwelo ekhumi nabibili.
Aka Petero yarumbula khukaYesu
Olwa yali nalaamanga yenyene, yali nali nende abeechi abo; nabareeba ari Abemikanda baboolanga barie khwisie, mbu nisie wina?
Nibakalusia nibasunga bari Yohana Omubatisii; ne abandi baboola mbu Eliya; nabandi, mbu mulala khubalakusi bakhale alamuushe khandi.
Nabareeba mbu Neenyu muboolanga murie, mbu nisie wina? Petero nakalusia, nasunga mbu Niwe Kristo waNyasaye.
Yesu yaboola akokhufwakhwe
Naye nabakaaria nabalaka butinyu oburamuboolelakhwo omundu yesi likhuwa elo ta;
naboola mbu Kamukhoyeele Omwana wOmundu okhwifwila amakhuwa amanji, nokhulobwa nende abakofu nabakuhani abakhulundu nabahandiichi, nokhwirwa, nokhulamusibwa khunyanga yakhataru.
Nababoolela bosi ari Omundu yesi naba niyeenya okhuba omulondi wanje, yeekaanie omwene, yeetuushe omusalabakwe buli nyanga, yanondenjekhwo.
Okhuba owenya okhuhonia obulamubwe, alabukosia; ne oubukosia obulamubwe khulwanje, omwenoyo alabuhonia.
Shichila kamukaasila shiina omundu, naba niyeenyooleia eshialo eshilamba, ne obulamubwe nibukora kata okhumubukulwakhwo?

Shichila omundu yesi oufwimbilwa isie nende amakhuwa kanje omurwe, neniye owa Omwana wOmundu alamufwimbilwa omurwe olwa yeetsa muluyali lulwe omwene nende oluyali lwaSamwana, nende olwabamalaika abatakatifu.
Ne emuboolela tieeli, mbu baliho khubasinjiile hano bano, abaraiikoonyelelakhwo khukhufwa nibarashialolakhwo Obwami bwaNyasaye tawe.
Okhukalulwa khwelikondo liaYesu
Mana olunyuma lwetsindaalo shinga munaane okhurula khumakhuwa ako, yabukula Petero nende Yakobo nende Yohana natsia ninabo mushikulu okhusaaya.
Ne olwa yali nasaayanga, obukondo bwomumonimwe bwakalukhana, tsingubotsie nitsikwa tsindafu, nitsihenukha.
Ne lola, abasaatsa babili bali nibasungananga ninaye; bali Musa nende Eliya;
nibaloleshela muluyali, nibasunga khukhwinyokhakhwe okhwa yali nali okhuusilia eYerusalemu.
Ne tsimoni tsiaPetero nende aba yali ninabo tsiali nitsisitoohe khulwa tsindoolo; ne olwa bamala babe meeso, balola oluyalilwe, nende abasaatsa abo babili abasinjiile ninaye.

Ne olwa yabo bali nibali okhulekhana nunaye, Petero namusunjila Yesu ari Omwechesia, nobulayi ifwe okhuba hano; lekha khuumbashe amatili kataru, elala elilio, elindi liaMusa, nelindi liaEliya; ne naramanya eshia aboola tawe.
Ne olwa yali nashiboolanga amakhuwa ako, lileesi niliitsa nilibafwimba; nibaria olwa beenjila mwileesi.
Omwoyo nikurula mwileesi, nikusunga kuri Uno niye Omwana wanje, omulobole wanje; mumuhulilenje.
Ne olwa omwoyo okwo kwali nikwakhahuliilikha, Yesu yanyoolekha yenyene. Nabo nibaholeela butswa, nibaraboolela omundu yesi mundaalo etsio khumakhuwa aka bali nibaluutsi tawe.
Yesu yahonia omwana owali nelidimoni
Ne khunyanga yakhabili, olwa bali nibeeshile okhurula mushikulu, omukanda omukali nikumubukaanila.
Ne lola, omusaatsa undi khubomukanda yalanga ari Omwechesia, ekhusaaya mbu omulolekhwo omusiani wanje; shichila nomwana wanje omuteelwa;
ne lola, roho undi amuhambanga, ne nonoho ayiibanga; ne amubahasinjia, okhuula olwa lifilo lifwitukha mumunwakwe, naramulekha bwangu ta, namusaalisia muno.
Nimbasaaya abeechibo mbu bamurusie; ne bakhayilwe.
Yesu nakalusia nasunga ari Inywe abolwibulo olurambatsanu, olurasuubila ta, ndalabeetsanga nineenywe okhuula liina, nimwisimilisilia? Leera omwanawo hano.
Ne olwa yali nashiitsanga, lidimoni nilimukhupa hasi, nilimubahasia muno. Ne Yesu yakondeshela roho weshifwabwi, nahonia omwana, namukalusilia samwana.
Bosi nibang'ang'aala olwa balola obukhulundu bwaNyasaye.
Yesu yaboola khandi akokhufwakhwe
Ne olwa bosi bali nibachenyanga khumakhuwa kosi aka yakholanga, yasunjila abeechibe ari
Amakhuwa kano mukatiile mumarwi keenywe; okhuba Omwana wOmundu alahaanwa mumakhono kabandu.
Ne shibatiila khushisina shiamakhuwa ako ta; kababiswa, baleshe okhukamanya; nibaria okhumureeba khumakhuwa ako.
Niwina ouli omukhongo?
Nibachaaka okhukanakania, mbu niwina khubo oukhoyile okhuba omukhongo?
Ne olwa Yesu yalola obukanakanii obwomumioyo chiabwe, yabukula omwana omutuutu namura aha yali,
nabasunjila ari Omundu yesi owinjisia omwana omutuutu uno khulwa eliira lianje, yanzinjisia isie; ne ounzinjisia isie amwinjisia oyo owanduma; okhuba ouli omutuutu mwinywe mwesi, omwenoyo nomukhongo.
Ouramufukula ta nowolubeka Iweenywe
Yohana nakalusia, nasunga mbu Omwechesia, khwaluutsi oundi narusinjia amadimoni khulwa eliiralio, nikhumukaania, shichila shialondananga nineefwe ta.
Ne Yesu namuboolela ari Muramukaaninjia tawe; shichila ouramufukula ta nowolubeka lweenywe.
Abelitaala liabaSamaria abaramwinjisia Yesu ta
Mana olwa tsindaalo tsiokhukulusibwakhwe tsiali nitsili okhuula, yasaabila okhutsia eYerusalemu,
naruma abarume imbeliwe; nabo nibatsia, nibeenjila mwitaala lindi liabaSamaria, mbu bamurecheshele amakhuwa.
Ne abayo shibamwinjisia ta, shichila yeengana outsia eYerusalemu.
Mana olwa abeechibe Yakobo nende Yohana balola, basunga bari Omwami, wenya mbu khulache omulilo kwishe kurule mwikulu, kubamulule?
Ne yashiukhana, nabakondeshela.
Mana nibatsia mwitaala lindi.
Abandi beenya okhulonda khuYesu
Ne olwa bali nibali khunjila nibatsutsanga, omundu undi yamusunjila ari Ndalakhulondakhwo hosi hosi aha otsia.
Yesu namukalusia mbu Amabwe kali nende ameena kako, amanyonyi akokhwikulu nako kali nebitsu biako; ne Omwana wOmundu shialikhwo nende ewa akonia omurwekwe ta.
Ne yasunjila oundi ari Nondakhwo. Naye nasunga mbu Omwami, chama enzie mbeli emuyabile papa.
Namusunjila mbu Lekha abafu beene bayabile abafu babwe; nawe, tsia otswanie akobwami bwaNyasaye.
Oundi khandi naboola mbu Nasi ndalakhulondakhwo, Omwami; ne chama enzie mbeli eseebulane nende abeweefwe.
Nebutswa Yesu namusunjila mbu Omundu yesi ouba natiilile amakhono khumbako yetsing'ombe mana nakhupa amashemo inyuma, shiakwanile obwami bwaNyasaye tawe.
